source_glosses_json: ["A pigment (or dye)-based fluid used for writing, printing etc."]

source_glosses_json: ["An author of novels."]

source_glosses_json: ["Extremely large; greatly exceeding the common size, extent, etc."]

source_glosses_json: ["Better than the average; superior due to exception or rarity."]
